notes.title: Reiza Simracing Bonanza - Final week round-up!
Reiza Simracing Bonanza - Final week round-up!
Reiza SimRacing Bonanza - Crowdfunding campaign launched!
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7q6t4cR1ueo

Help us take our racing simulators to the next level!

We are very pleased to announce the launch of Reiza Sim Racing Bonanza! a crowdfunding campaign targetted to raise a complementary budget for continuing developing Game Stock Car Extreme & Formula Truck 2013 further for a substantial short-term evolution. 

Our objective is to strengthen this platform for our users to enjoy over the next year and a half while we focus on the development of our new game. 

[url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/reiza-simracing-bonanza#/story]Click here[/url] for a full breakdown of all the details!
